name: Serpang
title: Wind Moon Sect
description: A girl of the Wind Moon Sect who crossed over from the Eastern Continent together with a Mystic called Toto. She dislikes inconvenience and often tries to skip training.
introduction:
A girl hailing from the Wind Moon Sect with a high affinity for Mystics.

As Serpang was weak since she was just a child, her father enrolled her in the sect to improve her health. She lacked talent in martial arts and fell behind other students, but after meeting Toto, a Mystic, she began improving rapidly. However, because she hates anything bothersome, she often skips training and gets scolded by her senior brothers and sisters.

She only decided to join the Journey after hearing that those who pass it receive not only the power of the Star Savior, but also substantial, regular support money.
